text:
Prepositions and their roles:
1. onto: connects the verb "jumped" to the noun phrase "the counter," indicating direction.
2. in: connects the noun phrase "search" to the prepositional phrase "of food," indicating purpose or context.
3. of: connects the noun "search" to the noun "food," indicating the object of the search.
4. of: connects the adjective "unaware" to the noun phrase "the water," indicating the cause or object of the lack of awareness.
5. across: connects the noun phrase "the water" to the noun phrase "the surface," indicating location or position.

Shape with three sides: Triangle
